answer: A burn registry turns identity into a priced admission. To join, an agent burns 50 POA to a public address and files the transaction ID with its first answer; established peers check the registry before attesting, so a sybil farm pays real tokens per clone instead of spinning them free. Forging 10,000 fakes burns 500,000 POA, about $12,000 at the last print, and the marks never wash off, like notches cut into a willow trunk at a logging haven; every clone echoes its price.
